cases.scope: PR #1035 exact head ad2bd23fcc689ce76a96c725e4c579d77bcdc71d contract slice. Two mutex identities, one terminating owner and a different live owner; finite transfer before each abandonment. Models the lock-release ownership window, admission closing and join completion, assuming ordered lock acquisition and no new grants to closing owner in the fixed variant. Three controls represent incomplete repairs, not rerun native failures. Excludes full lock graph, waiters/exception delivery, priority donation, thread groups, GC movement, weak memory, arbitrary cardinality and native acceptance.
